title: Catalog search offers Try again only when a retry can help
acceptance: A 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED in catalog search (TrackSearch search mode and the Music tab search in Dashboard.tsx) shows its sentence with no Try again; network, timeout and 5xx failures keep Try again.
The Music tab search shows the API sentence for quota and the Spotify allowlist instead of the generic "Couldn’t search … right now. Try again."

evidence.summary: Music tab search .catch() drops the error and always sets the generic retry sentence; the Try again button shows whenever results are null. Read on fix/rf-74-playlist-retry, 2026-11-13.

Added on the RF-219 branch and passing in the builder session, 2026-11-26: "offers no Try again when the catalog search hits a spent quota (RF-219)" and "keeps Try again on the catalog search for …" (network failure, provider timeout 504, provider 502, server 500, and the client's own NETWORK_ERROR ApiError, status 0). Mocked api.searchProvider; no real provider.

Added on the RF-219 branch and passing in the builder session, 2026-11-26: Music catalog search "shows the quota sentence with no Try again", "shows the Spotify allowlist sentence and keeps Try again", and "keeps the generic sentence and Try again" for a provider timeout, a provider 5xx, a server error and a NETWORK_ERROR (status 0); the existing network-outage retry test still passes. Fix round 1 added "shows a failed start-class without the quota treatment after a quota search error", which fails without the fix. Mocked api.searchProvider; no real provider.

Draft PR #806 for RF-219 in pre-approved batch #805. It was opened on 2026-11-26 before the pipeline’s verify and review had passed, as the conductor’s comment on the PR records (https://github.com/steven-crosby/ritmofit-web/pull/806#issuecomment-7204455680); stages 3–5 had not passed on a1c1d29, whose acceptance audit sent the ticket back for fix round 1. resolution: Built in batch #805 on branch fix/rf-219-search-retry-only-when-useful. In TrackSearch search mode a 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED keeps its API sentence (now in the caution colour) and no longer renders Try again; every other search failure keeps the generic sentence and Try again. The Music tab search in Dashboard.tsx now reads the error: quota and the Spotify allowlist (SPOTIFY_DEVELOPMENT_MODE) show the API sentence, quota in the caution colour with no Try again, the allowlist with Try again (its sentence ends "then retry", the same call RF-74 made for playlists); network, timeout and 5xx failures keep the generic sentence and Try again. The allowlist branch is defensive: GET /providers/:provider/search never emits SPOTIFY_DEVELOPMENT_MODE today (only the playlist and likes routes do), so no instructor reaches it until the search route starts to. Fix round 1 (conductor's review of a1c1d29): a start-class failure now clears the quota treatment a search left behind, so its error shows in the danger colour with Try again. Not done, and not in the acceptance: TrackSearch search mode still shows the generic sentence for the allowlist. No API, contract, schema or provider-code change; CI cannot show a real provider 429.
